title: Lightning Error Event Type - Data API
description: Lightning Error events represent errors that occurred during user interactions with Lightning Experience and the Salesforce mobile app. This event type is available in the EventLogFile object in API version 39.0 and later.

APP_NAME.description: The name of the application that the user accessed.

BROWSER_NAME.description: The name of the browser that the user accessed.

BROWSER_VERSION.description: The version of the browser that the user accessed in major.minor version format. Some browsers don’t provide a minor version.

CLIENT_GEO.description: The geolocation of the client in the form of <Country>/<State|Province>.

CLIENT_IP.description: The IP address of the client that’s using Salesforce services. A Salesforce internal IP (such as a login from AppExchange) is shown as “Salesforce.com IP”.

COMPONENT_NAME.description: The internal name of the standard component that generated the error. The Salesforce developer assigned the name when the standard component was created.

CONNECTION_TYPE.possible_values: CDMA1x CDMA EDGE EVDO0 EVDOA EVDOB GPRS HRPD HSDPA HSUPA LTE WIFI

DEVICE_ID.description: The unique identifier used to identify a device when tracking events. DEVICE_ID is a generated value that’s created when the mobile app is initially run after installation.

DEVICE_MODEL.description: The name of the device model.

DEVICE_PLATFORM.description: The type of application experience in name:experience:form format.
DEVICE_PLATFORM.possible_values: name: APP_BUILDER, CUSTOM, S1, SFX experience: BROWSER, HYBRID form: DESKTOP, PHONE, TABLET

DEVICE_SESSION_ID.description: The unique identifier of the user’s session based on page load time. If the user reloads a page, it starts a new session.

EVENT_TYPE.description: The type of event. The value is always LightningError.

LOGIN_KEY.description: The string that ties together all events in a user’s login session. It starts with a login event and ends with either a logout event or the user session expiring.

OS_NAME.description: The operating system name, derived from USER_AGENT.

OS_VERSION.description: The operating system version, derived from USER_AGENT.

PAGE_APP_NAME.description: The internal name of the application that the user accessed from the App Launcher.

PAGE_CONTEXT.description: Context of the page where the event occurred.

PAGE_ENTITY_ID.description: The unique entity identifier of the event.

PAGE_ENTITY_TYPE.description: The entity type of the event.

PAGE_START_TIME.description: The time when the page was initially loaded, measured in milliseconds.

PAGE_URL.description: Relative URL of the top-level Lightning Experience or Salesforce mobile app page that the user opened. The page can contain one or more Lightning components. Multiple record IDs can be associated with PAGE_URL.

REQUEST_ID.description: The unique ID of a single transaction. A transaction can contain one or more events. Each event in a given transaction has the same REQUEST_ID.

SDK_APP_VERSION.description: The mobile SDK application version number.

SESSION_KEY.description: The user’s unique session ID. You can use this value to identify all events in Lightning Experience within a session. When a user logs out and logs in again, a new session is started.

STACK_TRACE.description: The stack trace contains the location in the code where the error occurred along with the calling frames that led to the error.

TIMESTAMP.description: The access time of Salesforce services in GMT.

TIMESTAMP_DERIVED.description: The access time of Salesforce services in ISO8601-compatible format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ).

UI_EVENT_ID.description: ID of the Lightning event type.

UI_EVENT_SEQUENCE_NUM.description: An auto-incremented sequence number of the current event since the session started.

UI_EVENT_SOURCE.description: The source of the error event.
UI_EVENT_SOURCE.examples: Here are some examples of error flags returned in this field. AuraError Error InvalidStateError RangeError ReferenceError SecurityError SyntaxError TypeError unknown

UI_EVENT_TIMESTAMP.description: The time at which this event occurred, measured in milliseconds.

USER_AGENT.description: The numeric code for the type of client used to make the request (for example, browser, application, or API) as a string.

USER_ID.description: The 15-character ID of the user accessing Salesforce services through the UI or API.

USER_ID_DERIVED.description: The 18-character case-insensitive ID of the user who’s using Salesforce services through the UI or the API.

USER_TYPE.description: The category of user license of the user accessing Salesforce services through the UI or API.
USER_TYPE.possible_values: A: Automated Process b: High Volume Portal C: Customer Portal User D: External Who F: Self Service G: Guest L: Package License Manager N: Salesforce to Salesforce n: CSN Only O: Power Custom o: Custom P: Partner p: Customer Portal Manager S: Standard X: Salesforce Administrator
